# Test: config list shows every .grove.toml field in shared and effective output
setup_workspace
cp $WORK/all-fields.toml .grove.toml

exec grove config list --shared
stdout '^plain=false$'
stdout '^debug=false$'
stdout '^nerd_fonts=false$'
stdout '^stale_threshold=45d$'
stdout '^preserve.patterns=.env.custom$'
stdout '^preserve.exclude=vendor$'
stdout '^preserve.directories=.claude$'
stdout '^link.patterns=.cache$'
stdout '^hooks.add=make setup$'
stdout '^autolock.patterns=release/\*$'

exec grove config list
stdout '^plain=false$'
stdout '^debug=false$'
stdout '^nerd_fonts=false$'
stdout '^stale_threshold=45d$'
stdout '^preserve.patterns=.env.custom$'
stdout '^preserve.exclude=vendor$'
stdout '^preserve.directories=.claude$'
stdout '^link.patterns=.cache$'
stdout '^hooks.add=make setup$'
stdout '^autolock.patterns=release/\*$'

-- all-fields.toml --
plain = false
debug = false
nerd_fonts = false
stale_threshold = "45d"

[preserve]
patterns = [".env.custom"]
exclude = ["vendor"]
directories = [".claude"]

[link]
patterns = [".cache"]

[hooks]
add = ["make setup"]

[autolock]
patterns = ["release/*"]
